added_keys.answerLabel: Your answer. Use it only before a current direct Yes, No or Not yet judged. Do not put it before Derived No, Reassess or an unresolved mapping.
added_keys.earlierStrength: Earlier stronger reason. Use it on value-summary rows for a stale saved comparison, instead of earlierAnswer.
added_keys.supportDirection: Reason to SUPPORT. Use it for an argument's direction in the row eyebrow, so a direction cannot be read as an initial outcome.
added_keys.opposeDirection: Reason to OPPOSE. Use it the same way as supportDirection.
added_keys.pageStatusGroup: Page progress. Use it as the status-filter group label for Complete, Needs review and Has notes.

accepted_meaning_rules_for_implementer: The Yes and No filter statuses match current direct answers only. Derived No, Reassess and Mapping question unresolved are separate statuses.

An argument or claim row shows exactly one of the following. A current direct answer appears as answerLabel plus Yes or No. An unanswered item appears as answerLabel plus Not yet judged. A derived result appears as derivedNo alone. A stale judgment shows the Reassess badge. An unresolved mapping shows unresolvedMappingLabel. Use earlierAnswer for a retained direct judgment.
A Derived No row has no Reassess badge, matching the NodePage, which suppresses the stale notice for derived results.

Group the status-filter options. Under answerLabel: Yes, No and Not yet judged. Then Derived No, Reassess and Mapping question unresolved. Under initialOutcome: Support, Oppose, Both, Neither and Pending. Under strength: Pending, with a distinct status ID such as strengthPending. Under pageStatusGroup: Complete, Needs review and Has notes.

A value-summary row shows initialOutcome and strength. When the initial outcome is not Both, strength shows noDecision rather than Pending. The strength label is Stronger reason, not Comparison, so it does not look like the existing bill 'Comparison:' label.
needsReview means the page is not complete, matching the existing 'page needs review'. It is separate from reassess, which means a judgment is stale.
resultsLabel uses the {count} and {total} placeholders, which the app fills in.
scope.clear_filters_label: Acceptable.
